sources.title: README.md · barozp/Qwen3.8-27B-MTP-GGUF at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GGUF of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B with its Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) head preserved for self-speculative decoding in llama.cpp. Dense architecture (not MoE), so this is a straightforward tensor extraction, no expert remapping involved. Plain + MTP — base model with self-speculative decoding enabled.
